checkpoint_review: The Router was largely correct but slightly too lenient on the 'matte plastic' checkpoint. While it correctly marked it as false (due to the chrome finish), it should have noted that this is a semantic mismatch between the generic taxonomy (modern keyboard) and the specific instance (vintage typewriter). For alignment scoring, I will treat the visual identification of a 'typewriter space bar' as sufficient for class conformance, overriding the material mismatch. The 'underside stabilizer' checkpoint was correctly marked untestable. All geometric checkpoints passed.
artifact_review: The Router identified three key artifacts: texture anomaly (pebbled casing), structural collapse (right-side levers), and geometry distortion (wobbly keys). I agree with these findings. The 'texture_anomaly' severity (2.5) is appropriate; the casing looks like noisy AI generation rather than realistic leatherette or paint. The 'structural_collapse' (3.0) is also accurate; the mechanical linkages on the right are nonsensical and fused. The 'geometry_distortion' (2.0) is valid; the circular keys are not perfect circles. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed the structural issues (as expected) but confirmed slight compression/noise. The Geometric Depth Auditor's depth map confirms the foreground/background separation is generally okay, but doesn't rule out the local fusion observed by the Router. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.96) only confirms the space bar is a single object, not that it is artifact-free.
alignment_reasoning: The image clearly depicts a space bar in the context of a vintage typewriter. It passes all geometric and functional checkpoints except for the material description ('matte plastic' vs 'chrome'). Since 'space bar' is the class label and the object is undeniably a space bar, the material mismatch is a minor taxonomic nuance rather than a failure of generation. The Fine-Grained Classifier ranked 'space bar' as #2 (very close to #1 'mailbag'), which supports strong alignment despite the vintage context confusing the modern-trained classifier slightly.
artifact_reasoning: Significant artifacts are present. The black body of the typewriter has a muddy, pebbled texture inconsistent with real materials (Severity 2.5). The mechanical levers on the right side suffer from structural collapse and fusion (Severity 3.0). The circular keys exhibit slight geometric warping (Severity 2.0). These issues prevent a high artifact score, placing it below the 'mid' reference (3.0) due to the combination of texture and structural errors.
